title: Executive Modification of Statutory Service Benefits
description: **Simran Sidhu and Shivani Pant Introduction In India, the retirement benefits for government employees have long been a contentious issue because of their nature. These benefits while providing an incentive to the population in the form of post-job security for joining the services, also impose a huge burden on the exchequer of the state.
